comms_volume.note: Fictional data generated for this demo -- not connected to any real NWW/consular system.

acled.attribution: Data from ACLED (acleddata.com), via HDX aggregated country files -- no login required. ACLED must be clearly credited wherever this data or a derivative is shown.
acled.note: Monthly resolution only; the single most recent available month is excluded from scoring as provisional (reporting/verification lag consistently understates it) -- see Scripts/README.md.
